title: Smash Up
description: Smash Up is a 2-4 player card battle game! Combine two different factions to compete for base control and victory points; the first to 15 points wins. The base game includes 8 distinct factions, enabling many strategic pairings and playstyles. (Year: 2012; Type: Competitive/Card; Rating: 7.2)

madness.title: Madness Cards
madness.description: Madness cards come from the shared Madness deck and are never part of your starting deck. At game end, every 2 Madness cards you still keep cost you 1 VP.

bury.title: Bury
bury.description: Bury places a card face down beside a base. Buried cards stay in play but are not usable by default until another card effect lets you uncover, move, or replay them.

duel.title: Duel
duel.description: A duel makes two minions compare their power in a separate showdown and resolve through the duel flow. Only cards that explicitly say they start a duel enter this extra resolution.

tutorial.title: Smash Up Tutorial
tutorial.welcome: Welcome to Smash Up! Combine two factions, fight for base control, and be the first to reach 15 victory points.
tutorial.finish: Tutorial complete — you are ready to smash up!

cowboysDuel.title: Cowboys: Duel Tutorial
cowboysDuel.description: Walk through a fixed duel sequence featuring Pinkerton, duel-card timing, and Deputy resolution.

steps.setup: Preparing the Cowboys duel tutorial scenario…
steps.duelIntro: This tutorial focuses only on the Cowboys duel mechanic. You will see the challenge, Pinkerton counter timing, duel-card windows, and Deputy boost before the duel resolves.
steps.playGunfighter: Play Gunfighter first, then target the enemy Microbot in the Saloon to start the duel.
steps.pecosBillWindow: When the duel starts, the Cowboys titan Pecos Bill asks whether you want to discard a card and join this duel. Skip it here so the tutorial can stay focused on the core duel flow.
steps.pinkertonCounter: Pinkerton triggers before duel cards resolve. Place 1 +1 power counter on your dueling minion.
steps.duelCard: Now your duel-card window opens. Skip it in this tutorial so we can focus on the core Cowboys duel flow.
steps.opponentDuelCard: The opponent has no extra response here, so the tutorial will automatically pass their duel-card window.
steps.deputyBoost: Discard Deputy now to give Gunfighter +2 power until end of turn and secure the duel win.
steps.finish: The duel has resolved: the enemy minion is gone, Deputy is in your discard pile, and there is no active duel left. You have completed the core Cowboys duel flow.

steps.aiPlayMinion:
Look! Our "Star-Spawn of Cthulhu" has appeared on the base.

This power-5 minion has a Talent ability — you'll get to activate it shortly.
steps.welcome:
Welcome to Smash Up!

This first lesson avoids Madness cards. You are playing Wizards + Robots: Wizards create extra play windows, and Robots turn those windows into more minions.

The goal is concrete: read the table, then use one combo to fight for a base.
steps.scoreboard:
This is the scoreboard. VP means Victory Points, and the first player to 15 VP wins.

The opponent score bubble is also clickable. You often want to inspect the opponent's public area before deciding which base to pressure.
steps.opponentView:
Hidden but important: click the opponent score bubble to switch to the opponent public view.

You can inspect their public area, deck/discard counts, and board commitment. Click Back when you want to return to your own view.
steps.deckDiscardIntro:
Your deck and discard pile sit in the lower-left area.

Click the deck to inspect remaining cards and deck contents; click the discard pile to review used cards. Robots and Wizards often care about drawing, checking the deck, and chaining from the deck, so this area matters.
steps.handIntro:
This is your hand. You have four key cards now:

• Chronomage: a minion that grants an extra action window
• Summon: an action that lets you play an extra minion
• Zapbot: a small Robot that keeps the minion chain going
• Tech Center: draws based on your minions at a base
steps.turnTracker:
This shows the current turn and phase.

Each turn moves through Play Cards → Score Bases → Draw. This lesson first builds a combo in Play Cards, then checks whether a base can score.
steps.endTurnBtn: This is the End Phase button. After you're done with each phase, click it to move on.
steps.playCardsExplain:
It is the Play Cards phase.

The basic rule is 1 minion and 1 action each turn, but this pairing is fun because it breaks that limit: Wizards open windows, and Robots turn those windows into board presence.
steps.playChronomage:
First play Chronomage.

Click Chronomage in your hand and place it on Central Brain. It adds 3 power and grants you an extra action window.
steps.playSummon:
Chronomage gave you an extra action. Use it to play Summon.

Summon lets you play an extra minion. In other words, the Wizard action turns into more board presence.
steps.extraZapbot:
Use Summon's extra minion window to play Zapbot.

Place it on Central Brain too. Zapbot is small, but it keeps opening extra minion opportunities. This is the first combo beat: Wizard opens the door, Robot rushes through.
steps.comboBoardRead:
Pause and read the board: Central Brain now has your Chronomage and Zapbot, while the opponent also has Robots there.

When you click or zoom cards and bases, check two things: how far the base is from its breakpoint, and who contributes which power.
steps.playTechCenter:
Now play Tech Center.

Choose Central Brain as the target. It draws based on your minions there, so the extra Robot you played immediately turns into card advantage.
steps.deckAfterDraw:
After drawing, inspect the deck and discard pile again.

You can see the deck count change, Tech Center move to discard, and new cards enter your hand. This is why the tutorial teaches this area: it helps you track resources.
steps.endPlayCards:
The play sequence is done. You did not just play several cards; you completed a chain: Chronomage grants an extra action → Summon grants an extra minion → Zapbot adds board presence → Tech Center draws from that board presence.

Click the end button to enter scoring.
steps.baseScoring:
A base scores when the total power on that base reaches its breakpoint.

This is where table reading matters: whoever has the most power there gets the best VP reward, and minions on the scored base go to discard afterward.
steps.vpAwards:
VP rewards are awarded by power rank on the scoring base.

That is why this lesson teaches opponent view and power sources: you are deciding where to fight, not just what you can play.
steps.drawExplain: The Draw phase refills your hand. You can keep checking the deck and discard pile to confirm where this turn's cards went.
steps.handLimit:
Note the hand limit is 10 cards.

If you exceed the limit after drawing, you must discard down to 10.
steps.endDraw: Draw phase complete! When your hand is at or under 10 cards, the phase advances automatically.
steps.opponentTurn:
It is the opponent's turn now.

Watch where they commit minions. When needed, click the opponent score bubble to inspect their public view, then return to your own view.
steps.talentIntro:
Some minions have Talent abilities that can be used once per turn.

Look for the Talent marker on minion cards! Talents reset at the start of your turn.
steps.turnCycle:
Turns alternate between players through Play Cards, Scoring, and Draw.

Next turn, use the same habit: inspect opponent public information and base power before deciding where to fire your combo.
steps.summary:
The core lesson is not memorizing rules. It is a usable read:

• Wizards create extra windows
• Robots convert windows into board presence
• Deck and discard show where resources went
• Opponent view tells you which base to fight for
steps.finish:
Basic tutorial complete.

When you see a new faction, ask what it provides: windows, board presence, draw, movement, or scoring pressure. Then look for a second faction that combines with it.

itty_critters_rainboroc.name: Rainboroc
itty_critters_rainboroc.effectText: Special: After you win a base while this titan is not in play, you may play it on the base that replaces it. Ongoing: After the first time each turn you play a minion of power 2 or less here, place a +1 power counter on this titan. Talent: Shuffle a minion of power 2 or less from your discard pile into your deck. If you do, you may move this titan to another base.

kaiju_gorgodzolla.name: Gorgodzolla
kaiju_gorgodzolla.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this titan on a base where you have two or more actions. Ongoing: After you play an action or a minion on this base, place a +1 power counter on this titan. Ongoing: After you play an action on this base, you may draw a card.

magical_girls_walking_castle.name: Walking Castle
magical_girls_walking_castle.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this titan on a base where you have at least two minions. Ongoing: Your minions here cannot be destroyed by other players' card effects. Talent: Move this titan and up to three of your minions from here to another base.

mega_troopers_megabot.name: Megabot
mega_troopers_megabot.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this titan on a base where you have at least three minions. Ongoing: You have +1 power here for each of your minions here. Special: Before another base scores, you may move this titan there.

penguins_emperor_penguin.name: Emperor Penguin
penguins_emperor_penguin.effectText: Special: At the start of your turn, you may play this titan on a base where you have three or more minions. Ongoing: You may play minions off the top of your deck here instead of your regular minion play. Talent: Reveal a minion of power 3 or less in your hand or discard pile and shuffle it into your deck to place a +1 power counter on this titan.

penguins_surfing_penguin.name: Surfing Penguin
penguins_surfing_penguin.abilityText: You may move a minion from here to another base.

penguins_dancing_penguin.name: Dancing Penguin
penguins_dancing_penguin.abilityText: Special: When you play another minion, you may play this minion to the same base instead. Place that minion on the bottom of its owner's deck; it has no effect.

penguins_snazzy_penguin.name: Snazzy Penguin
penguins_snazzy_penguin.abilityText: If this minion was played from the top of your deck, draw two cards.

penguins_command_penguin.name: Command Penguin
penguins_command_penguin.abilityText: Play a minion from the top of your deck as an extra minion.

penguins_disguise_penguin.name: Disguise Penguin
penguins_disguise_penguin.abilityText: Talent: Place this minion on the bottom of your deck to play a minion from the top of your deck here as an extra minion. Use this ability only once per turn.

penguins_secret_mission.name: Secret Mission
penguins_secret_mission.effectText: Place any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck. Draw that many cards, then shuffle your deck.

penguins_the_hatching.name: The Hatching
penguins_the_hatching.effectText: Play a minion from the top of your deck as an extra minion.

penguins_regurgitating_penguin.name: Regurgitating Penguin
penguins_regurgitating_penguin.abilityText: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. You may place one action revealed this way into your hand. Put the rest back on top of your deck in any order.

penguins_baby_penguin.name: Baby Penguin
penguins_baby_penguin.abilityText: If this minion was played from the top of your deck, you may play an extra minion of power 3 or less here.

penguins_a_wish_for_wings_that_work.name: A Wish For Wings That Work
penguins_a_wish_for_wings_that_work.effectText: Choose a base. Play Emperor Penguin there, OR your minions there gain +1 power until the end of the turn.

penguins_leaping_aboard.name: Leaping Aboard
penguins_leaping_aboard.effectText: Play on a base. Special: After this base scores, play a minion from the top of your deck as an extra minion on the replacement base.

penguins_i_cant_tell_them_apart.name: I Can't Tell Them Apart
penguins_i_cant_tell_them_apart.effectText: Shuffle any number of your minions on a base into your deck. Play the same number of minions from the top of your deck as extra minions there.

penguins_pebble_gift.name: Pebble Gift
penguins_pebble_gift.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After you play a minion from the top of your deck here, draw a card.

penguins_under_the_ice.name: Under the Ice
penguins_under_the_ice.effectText: Reveal the top five cards of your deck. Play a random minion among them as an extra minion. Place the rest on the bottom of their owners' decks in any order.

penguins_ice_slide.name: Ice Slide
penguins_ice_slide.effectText: Play on a base. Special: After this base scores, draw a card for each of your minions that goes from here to the discard pile.

sharks_helicoprion.name: Helicoprion
sharks_helicoprion.effectText: Special: At the start of your turn, or after any minion is destroyed, place a counter on this titan if it is not in play. After there are four or more counters on this titan, you may remove the counters and play it. Ongoing: On another player's turn, after any minion here is destroyed, you may search your deck and/or discard pile for a Mako and place it in your hand, OR draw a card. Talent: Play an extra minion.

superheroes_the_everything_glove.name: The Everything Glove
superheroes_the_everything_glove.effectText: Special: If you have three or more minions of power 5 or more in play, you may play this titan. Ongoing: Your minions here are not affected by other players' abilities. Talent: Play an extra minion of power 2 or less and/or an extra action until the end of the turn.

tornados_category_5.name: Category 5
tornados_category_5.effectText: Special: On your turn, after you move two or more minions in a turn, you may play this titan. Ongoing: You have +1 power here for each minion that moved to or from here this turn. Special: Before another base scores, you may move this titan there.

dinosaurs_fort_titanosaurus.name: Fort Titanosaurus
dinosaurs_fort_titanosaurus.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may destroy one of your minions here to play this titan here and place +1 power counters on it equal to that minion's power. Ongoing: Once per turn after you play an action on one of your minions, you may place a +1 power counter on that minion, this titan, or both. Talent: If this titan has at least 4 +1 power counters, draw a card.

ninjas_invisible_ninja.name: Invisible Ninja
ninjas_invisible_ninja.effectText: Special: On your turn, if this titan was not in play at the start of your turn, you may discard a card to play this titan at a base where you have a minion. Ongoing: At the start of your turn, you may destroy this titan to play an extra minion of power 3 or less. Ongoing: Once per turn, after you destroy another player's card or return one of your minions to your hand, you may look at the top two cards of your deck, draw one, and shuffle the other into your deck.

killer_plants_killer_kudzu.name: Killer Kudzu
killer_plants_killer_kudzu.effectText: Special: At the start of your turn, if this titan is not in play, place a +1 power counter on it. If it has 3 or more counters, you may play it instead of your regular minion. Ongoing: When this titan is removed from play, you may draw two cards or shuffle up to two minions from your discard pile into your deck. Talent: Remove this titan from play to play a minion from your discard pile with power less than or equal to its +1 power counters.

frankenstein_the_bride.name: The Bride
frankenstein_the_bride.effectText: Special: At the start of your turn, if you have no titan in play, choose two different effects: box a minion from your hand or discard pile, destroy one of your minions, or remove a +1 power counter from one of your minions. Then play this titan on a base. Ongoing: The first time each turn one of your minions gains or loses a +1 power counter, draw a card. Talent: Place a +1 power counter on one of your minions here, or remove two +1 power counters from your minions to play an extra action.

super_spies_moon_zero_three.name: Moon Zero Three
super_spies_moon_zero_three.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this titan on a base with no other players' minions. Ongoing: After the first time each turn an ability is used to reveal, look at, or search for one or more cards from a player's deck, place a +1 power counter on this titan. Talent: Look at the top card of any deck. Place it on the top or bottom of that deck.

time_travelers_time_box.name: Time Box
time_travelers_time_box.effectText: Special: At the start of your turn or when a card goes to your hand from play or the discard pile, place a counter on this titan if it is not in play. After you place the fifth or higher counter on it, you may remove all the counters and play this titan. Talent: Play an extra minion here of power 2 or less, and/or play an extra action.

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.effectText: Special: At the start of your turn, you may return one of your buried cards to your hand to play this titan on its base. Special: After a base scores while this titan is in play, you may return one of your buried cards there to your hand. Talent: Bury a card from your hand here.

bear_cavalry_major_ursa.name: Major Ursa
bear_cavalry_major_ursa.effectText: Special: You may play this titan on a base where you have a minion instead of playing a normal minion. Ongoing: After this titan moves to a base, you may move another player's minion of power 3 or less there to a different base. Talent: Place a +1 power counter on this titan, then move it to another base.

ghosts_creampuff_man.name: Creampuff Man
ghosts_creampuff_man.effectText: Special: During your turn, if you have no cards in hand, you may play this titan. Ongoing: You have +5 power here, minus the number of cards in your hand (minimum +0). Talent: Discard a card to play an extra action from your discard pile. Place that action on the bottom of your deck instead of your discard pile.

giant_ants_death_on_six_legs.name: Death on Six Legs
giant_ants_death_on_six_legs.effectText: Special: During your turn, if your minions have 7 or more +1 power counters, you may play this titan. Ongoing: Whenever a minion goes to the discard pile, move 1 +1 power counter from it onto this titan. Talent: Play an extra action.

innsmouth_dagon.name: Dagon
innsmouth_dagon.effectText: Special: During your turn, you may play this titan on a base where you have two or more minions with the same name. Ongoing: If there are minions with the same name here, each minion with that name gives you +1 power here. Talent: Play an extra minion.

cthulhu_cthulhu_titan.name: Cthulhu
cthulhu_cthulhu_titan.effectText: Special: You may draw 2 Madness cards to play this titan on a base where you have a minion instead of playing a normal action. Ongoing: After you play or draw a Madness card, place a +1 power counter on this titan. Talent: Draw a Madness card, or put a Madness card from your hand into another player's hand.

pirates_the_kraken.name: The Kraken
pirates_the_kraken.effectText: Special: If this titan is not in play, after a base where you have a minion scores, you may say "Release the Kraken!" to play it on the replacement base. Talent: Move this titan to another base. Other players' minions there each get -1 power until end of turn. Special: After this base scores, move one of your minions here to another base instead of discarding it.

tricksters_big_funny_giant.name: Big Funny Giant
tricksters_big_funny_giant.effectText: Special: You may play this titan on a base with no players' minions instead of playing a normal minion. Ongoing: Other players must discard a card to play a minion here. At the end of your turn, if there are no other players' minions here, place a +1 power counter on this titan. Talent: Destroy a minion of power 2 or less on this base to move this titan to another base.

tricksters_big_funny_giant_pod.name: Big Funny Giant
tricksters_big_funny_giant_pod.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this titan. Ongoing: After another player plays a minion here, they must discard a card. At the end of each other player's turn, if they do not have a minion here, you may place a +1 power counter on this titan. Special: When this base scores, if you are the winner and at least one other player does not have a minion here, gain 1 VP.

vampires_ancient_lord.name: Ancient Lord
vampires_ancient_lord.effectText: Special: After you place 2 or more +1 power counters on minions in a turn, you may play this titan. Ongoing: After you place a +1 power counter on one of your cards that doesn't already have a +1 power counter, place one additional +1 power counter on it. Talent: Place a +1 power counter on one of your minions here that already has a +1 power counter.

werewolves_great_wolf_spirit.name: Great Wolf Spirit
werewolves_great_wolf_spirit.effectText: Special: During your turn, if you have the most power on two or more bases, you may play this titan on one of them. Ongoing: During your turn, your cards may use one additional talent. Talent: One of your minions gets +1 power until end of turn.

wizards_arcane_protector.name: Arcane Protector
wizards_arcane_protector.effectText: Special: After you play 5 or more cards in a turn, you may play this titan. Ongoing: For every 3 cards in your hand, you have +1 power here. Talent: Draw a card.

base_the_homeworld.name: The Homeworld
base_the_homeworld.abilityText: After each time a minion is played here, its owner may play an extra minion of power 2 or less.

base_the_mothership.name: The Mothership
base_the_mothership.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner may return one of their minions of power 3 or less here to their hand.

base_temple_of_goju.name: Temple of Goju
base_temple_of_goju.abilityText: After this base scores, place each player's highest-power minion here on the bottom of its owner's deck.

base_cave_of_shinies.name: Cave of Shinies
base_cave_of_shinies.abilityText: After each time a minion is destroyed here, its owner gains 1 VP.

base_haunted_house.name: Haunted House
base_haunted_house.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner discards their hand and draws five cards.

base_rhodes_plaza.name: Rhodes Plaza Mall
base_rhodes_plaza.abilityText: When this base scores, each player gains 1 VP for each minion they have here.

base_the_factory.name: The Factory
base_the_factory.abilityText: When this base scores, the winner gains 1 VP for every 5 power they have here.

base_tar_pits.name: Tar Pits
base_tar_pits.abilityText: After each time a minion is destroyed here, place it on the bottom of its owner's deck.

base_ninja_dojo.name: Ninja Dojo
base_ninja_dojo.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner may destroy any one minion.

base_mushroom_kingdom.name: Mushroom Kingdom
base_mushroom_kingdom.abilityText: At the start of each player's turn, that player may move an opponent's minion from any base to here.

base_pirate_cove.name: Pirate Cove
base_pirate_cove.abilityText: After this base scores, all players other than the winner may move one of their minions from here to another base instead of placing it in the discard pile.

base_tortuga.name: Tortuga
base_tortuga.abilityText: After the winner scores, the runner-up may move one of their minions to the base that replaces this one.

base_great_library.name: Great Library
base_great_library.abilityText: After this base scores, each player with a minion here may draw a card.

base_wizard_academy.name: Wizard Academy
base_wizard_academy.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner looks at the top three cards of the base deck. They may choose one of those bases to replace this one, then place the other two on top of the base deck in any order.

base_the_factory_pod.name: Factory 436-1337
base_the_factory_pod.abilityText: When this base scores, the winner gains 1 VP for every 5 power they have here.

base_temple_of_goju_pod.name: Temple of Goju
base_temple_of_goju_pod.abilityText: After each time a minion is destroyed here, place it on the bottom of its owner's deck.

base_cave_of_shinies_pod.name: Cave of Shinies
base_cave_of_shinies_pod.abilityText: Once per turn, after a minion here you own is destroyed, gain 1 VP.

base_mushroom_kingdom_pod.name: Mushroom Kingdom
base_mushroom_kingdom_pod.abilityText: At the start of your turn, if you have more cards in your hand than any other player, you may move a minion to or from this base.

base_wizard_academy_pod.name: School of Wizardry
base_wizard_academy_pod.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner looks at the top three cards of the base deck, chooses one to replace this base, and returns the others in any order.

base_great_library_pod.name: The Great Library
base_great_library_pod.abilityText: After this base scores, all players with minions here may draw one card.

base_haunted_house_pod.name: Evans City Cemetery
base_haunted_house_pod.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner discards their hand and draws five cards.

base_rhodes_plaza_pod.name: Rhodes Plaza Mall
base_rhodes_plaza_pod.abilityText: When this base scores, each player gains 1 VP for each minion that player has here.

base_dread_lookout.name: Dread Lookout
base_dread_lookout.abilityText: Actions cannot be played on this base.

base_haunted_house_al9000.name: Haunted House
base_haunted_house_al9000.abilityText: After each time a player plays a minion here, they must discard a card.

base_the_field_of_honor.name: The Field of Honor
base_the_field_of_honor.abilityText: After each time one or more minions are destroyed here, the player who destroyed them gains 1 VP.

base_tsars_palace.name: Tsar's Palace
base_tsars_palace.abilityText: Minions of power 2 or less cannot be played here.

base_inventors_salon.name: Inventor's Salon
base_inventors_salon.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner may take an action from their discard pile into their hand.

base_the_workshop.name: The Workshop
base_the_workshop.abilityText: After each time a player plays an action on this base, they may play an extra action.

base_greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
base_greenhouse.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner may search their deck for a minion and play it on the replacement base.

base_secret_garden.name: Secret Garden
base_secret_garden.abilityText: On your turn, you may play one extra minion of power 2 or less here.

base_cat_fanciers_alley.name: Cat Fanciers' Alley
base_cat_fanciers_alley.abilityText: Once per turn, you may destroy one of your minions here to draw a card.

base_house_of_nine_lives.name: House of Nine Lives
base_house_of_nine_lives.abilityText: If a minion would be destroyed at another base, its owner may move it here instead.

base_enchanted_glade.name: Enchanted Glen
base_enchanted_glade.abilityText: After you play an action on a minion here, draw a card.

base_fairy_ring.name: Fairy Circle
base_fairy_ring.abilityText: The first time each turn you play a minion here, you may play an extra minion there or an extra action.

base_beautiful_castle.name: Beautiful Castle
base_beautiful_castle.abilityText: Minions here of power 5 or more are unaffected by other players' cards.

base_land_of_balance.name: Land of Balance
base_land_of_balance.abilityText: After you play a minion here, you may move one of your minions from another base to here.

base_pony_paradise.name: Pony Paradise
base_pony_paradise.abilityText: If you have two or more minions here, your minions here cannot be destroyed.

base_north_pole.name: North Pole
base_north_pole.abilityText: Each player may play only one minion at this base each turn.

base_antarctic_base.name: Antarctic Base
base_antarctic_base.abilityText: Each player may play only one minion at this base each turn.

base_ritual_site.name: Ritual Site
base_ritual_site.abilityText: After this base scores, shuffle all minions here into their owners' decks instead of placing them in the discard pile.

base_rlyeh.name: R'lyeh
base_rlyeh.abilityText: At the start of each player's turn, that player may destroy one of their minions here to gain 1 VP.

base_the_asylum.name: The Asylum
base_the_asylum.abilityText: After each time a minion is played here, its owner may consume a Madness card from their hand.

base_innsmouth_base.name: Innsmouth
base_innsmouth_base.abilityText: After each time a minion is played here, its owner may place a card from any player's discard pile on the bottom of its owner's deck.

base_mountains_of_madness.name: Mountains of Madness
base_mountains_of_madness.abilityText: After each time a minion is played here, its owner draws a Madness card.

base_miskatonic_university_base.name: Miskatonic University
base_miskatonic_university_base.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner may consume any number of Madness cards from their hand and discard pile.

base_plateau_of_leng.name: Plateau of Leng
base_plateau_of_leng.abilityText: The first time a player plays a minion here from their hand each turn, they may play an extra minion of the same name here.

base_the_pasture.name: The Pasture
base_the_pasture.abilityText: The first time a player moves a minion here each turn, they move a minion from another base to here.

base_sheep_shrine.name: Sheep Shrine
base_sheep_shrine.abilityText: After this base enters play, each player may move one of their minions to here.

base_castle_blood.name: Castle Blood
base_castle_blood.abilityText: After you play a minion here, if another player has more power here than you do, you may place a +1 power counter on that minion.

base_crypt.name: Crypt
base_crypt.abilityText: When one or more minions here are destroyed, the player who destroyed them may place a +1 power counter on one of his or her minions here.

base_laboratorium.name: Laboratorium
base_laboratorium.abilityText: After the first time each turn a minion is played here, its controller places a +1 power counter on it.

base_golem_schloss.name: Golem Schloß
base_golem_schloss.abilityText: After this base scores, the winner places a +1 power counter on each of their minions.

base_moot_site.name: Moot Site
base_moot_site.abilityText: After the first time each turn a minion is played here, it gains +2 power until the end of the turn.

base_standing_stones.name: Standing Stones
base_standing_stones.abilityText: During your turn, one of your minions here can use its Talent twice.

base_egg_chamber.name: Egg Chamber
base_egg_chamber.abilityText: Minions here with +1 power counters cannot be destroyed.

base_the_hill.name: The Hill
base_the_hill.abilityText: At the start of each player's turn, that player may move one of his or her minions from any base to here.

frankenstein_german_engineering.name: German Engineering
frankenstein_german_engineering.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After you play a minion here, place a +1 power counter on it.

frankenstein_jolt.name: Jolt
frankenstein_jolt.effectText: Place a +1 power counter on each of your minions.

frankenstein_grave_situation.name: Grave Situation
frankenstein_grave_situation.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: When one of your minions here would be destroyed, return it to your hand instead of the discard pile.

frankenstein_its_alive.name: Its Alive
frankenstein_its_alive.effectText: Play an extra minion. Place a +1 power counter on it.

frankenstein_angry_mob.name: Angry Mob
frankenstein_angry_mob.effectText: Choose one of your minions. Place any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck. For each card placed, place a +1 power counter on that minion.

frankenstein_igor.name: Igor
frankenstein_igor.abilityText: Ongoing: After this minion is destroyed or discarded, place a +1 power counter on one of your minions.

frankenstein_body_shop.name: Body Shop
frankenstein_body_shop.effectText: Destroy one of your minions. Place +1 power counters equal to its power on your minions, divided as you choose.

frankenstein_lab_assistant.name: Lab Assistant
frankenstein_lab_assistant.abilityText: Place a +1 power counter on one of your other minions.

frankenstein_uberserum.name: Uberserum
frankenstein_uberserum.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: At the start of your turn, place a +1 power counter on this minion. This minion cannot be destroyed.

frankenstein_the_monster.name: The Monster
frankenstein_the_monster.abilityText: Talent: Remove a +1 power counter from this minion to play an extra minion.

frankenstein_blitzed.name: Blitzed
frankenstein_blitzed.effectText: Remove any number of +1 power counters from your minions. Destroy a minion with power less than or equal to the number you removed.

frankenstein_herr_doktor.name: Herr Doktor
frankenstein_herr_doktor.abilityText: Talent: Place a +1 power counter on one of your other minions.

werewolf_full_moon.name: Full Moon
werewolf_full_moon.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Each of your minions here has +1 power.

werewolf_frenzy.name: Frenzy
werewolf_frenzy.effectText: Each of your minions of power 4 or more gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

werewolf_marking_territory.name: Marking Territory
werewolf_marking_territory.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: At the start of your turn, if you have more power here than each other player, reduce this base's breakpoint to 0.

werewolf_chew_toy.name: Chew Toy
werewolf_chew_toy.effectText: Choose one of your minions on a base. Destroy a minion there with less power than yours.

werewolf_leader_of_the_pack.name: Leader Of The Pack
werewolf_leader_of_the_pack.effectText: Play on a minion. Talent: If this minion has the most power here, you may play an extra action.

werewolf_howler.name: Howler
werewolf_howler.abilityText: This minion has +2 power until the end of the turn.

werewolf_unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
werewolf_unstoppable.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion cannot be destroyed.

werewolf_teenage_wolf.name: Teenage Wolf
werewolf_teenage_wolf.abilityText: Talent: This minion gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

werewolf_let_the_dog_out.name: Let The Dog Out
werewolf_let_the_dog_out.effectText: Choose one of your minions. Destroy any number of minions with total power less than or equal to that minion's power.

werewolf_loup_garou.name: Loup Garou
werewolf_loup_garou.abilityText: Special: Before this base scores, this minion has +2 power until the end of the turn.

werewolf_moontouched.name: Moontouched
werewolf_moontouched.effectText: Play on a minion. Talent: If this minion has the most power here, draw a card.

werewolf_pack_alpha.name: Pack Alpha
werewolf_pack_alpha.abilityText: Special: Before this base scores, each of your minions here gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

vampire_dinner_date.name: Dinner Date
vampire_dinner_date.effectText: Place a +1 power counter on one of your minions. Destroy a minion of power 2 or less at the same base.

russian_fairy_tales_go_see_my_sister_pod.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After you play or move one of your minions to here, you may draw a card.

russian_fairy_tales_bewitched_pod.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion has +2 power. When this minion leaves play, transfer this action to another minion.

russian_fairy_tales_transformation_pod.name: Transformation
russian_fairy_tales_transformation_pod.effectText: Place a minion on the bottom of its owner’s deck to have them play a minion off the top of their deck there as an extra minion, then shuffle their deck.

russian_fairy_tales_the_birch_pod.name: The Birch
russian_fairy_tales_the_birch_pod.abilityText: Ongoing: At the start of your turn, you may destroy this minion to search your hand, deck, and/or discard pile for The Birch Woman, and add it to your hand or play it here as an extra minion.

russian_fairy_tales_tsar_eagle_pod.name: Tsar Eagle
russian_fairy_tales_tsar_eagle_pod.abilityText: Draw a card OR place a minion from another player’s discard pile on top of their deck.

russian_fairy_tales_the_gray_wolf_pod.name: The Gray Wolf
russian_fairy_tales_the_gray_wolf_pod.abilityText: Talent: Place this minion on top of its owner’s deck to play an extra minion here and place a +1 power counter on it.

russian_fairy_tales_foolish_magician_pod.name: Foolish Magician
russian_fairy_tales_foolish_magician_pod.abilityText: Draw three cards, then place three cards from your hand on the top and/or bottom of your deck in any order.

russian_fairy_tales_toad_pod.name: Toad
russian_fairy_tales_toad_pod.abilityText: You may give control of this minion to another player to shuffle another one of their minions here into its owner’s deck.

russian_fairy_tales_mass_transformation_.name: Mass Transformation
russian_fairy_tales_mass_transformation_.effectText: Each player places their hand on the bottom of their deck and draws an equal number of cards.

ancient_incas_ashlar_masonry.name: Ashlar Masonry
ancient_incas_ashlar_masonry.effectText: Special: Play after a base scores. You may return one of your actions on that base to your hand and shuffle the rest of them into your deck instead of the discard pile.

ancient_incas_golden_condor.name: Golden Condor
ancient_incas_golden_condor.effectText: Return any number of your actions on bases to your hand. You must play each of them as an extra action.

ancient_incas_royal_highway.name: Royal Highway
ancient_incas_royal_highway.effectText: Play on a base. You may move one of your minions to or from here. Ongoing: After you play an action on another base, you may move one of your minions from here to there or from there to here.

ancient_incas_quipu_strings.name: Quipu Strings
ancient_incas_quipu_strings.effectText: Choose an action in your discard pile that can be played on a base and play it as an extra action.

ancient_incas_llama.name: Llama
ancient_incas_llama.abilityText: You may return one of your actions played on another base to your hand and play it here as an extra action.

ancient_incas_incan_engineer.name: Incan Engineer
ancient_incas_incan_engineer.abilityText: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal an action that can be played on a base. Add it to your hand. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

ancient_incas_child_of_the_sun.name: Child of the Sun
ancient_incas_child_of_the_sun.abilityText: Ongoing: After the first time you play an action on this base each turn, you may play an extra action.

ancient_incas_armory.name: Armory
ancient_incas_armory.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: You have +2 power here for each of your other actions on this base.

ancient_incas_fortress_walls.name: Fortress Walls
ancient_incas_fortress_walls.effectText: Play on a base. Place a +1 power counter on one of your minions here. Ongoing: After you play another action on this base, you may place a +1 power counter on one of your minions here.

ancient_incas_temple_of_the_sun.name: Temple of the Sun
ancient_incas_temple_of_the_sun.effectText: Play on a base. Draw a card. Ongoing: After you play another action on this base, draw a card.

ancient_incas_signs_in_the_stars.name: Signs in the Stars
ancient_incas_signs_in_the_stars.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Turn the top card of the base deck face up. While the top base card is face up this base also has its abilities. At the start of each player’s turn they may turn the top base card down until the end of the turn. Talent: Place the top card of the base deck on the bottom of the deck.

ancient_incas_sapa_inca.name: Sapa Inca
ancient_incas_sapa_inca.abilityText: Search your deck and/or discard pile for an action that can be played on a base, and add it to your hand. Ongoing: After you play an action on a base, place a +1 power counter on one your minions there.

base_anansis_web.name: Anansi's Web
base_anansis_web.abilityText: If you have a minion here, after the first time each turn you play a standard action, you may place it into another player’s hand instead of the discard pile to draw two cards.

base_storytellers_hut.name: Storyteller's Hut
base_storytellers_hut.abilityText: On your turn, you may play an extra action to place a counter on this card. This base’s breakpoint is reduced by 2 for each of those counters.

base_gingerbread_house.name: Gingerbread House
base_gingerbread_house.abilityText: Before this base scores, each player may choose two of their minions here with the same power to gain +2 power until the end of the turn.

base_woodland_cottage.name: Woodland Cottage
base_woodland_cottage.abilityText: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, you may search your deck for a minion of power 3 or less and place it into your hand.

base_transformation_spring.name: Transformation Spring
base_transformation_spring.abilityText: Once during your turn, after you play a minion here, you may place it on the bottom of its owner's deck to play a minion off the top of your deck here as an extra minion.

base_giant_turnip.name: Giant Turnip
base_giant_turnip.abilityText: This base’s breakpoint is reduced by 1 for each minion on it.

base_machu_picchu.name: Machu Picchu
base_machu_picchu.abilityText: After you play an action on this base, draw a card.

base_cuzcu.name: Cuzcu
base_cuzcu.abilityText: This base’s breakpoint is reduced by 3 for each action on it.

sheep_counting_sheep.name: Counting Sheep
sheep_counting_sheep.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Once per turn, after the power of another player's minion increases, your minions here gain +1 power until the end of the turn.

sheep_hello_dolly.name: Hello, Dolly!
sheep_hello_dolly.effectText: Special: Play after another player plays an action. Copy the ability of that action.

sheep_flock.name: Flock
sheep_flock.abilityText: Ongoing: After another minion moves from here to another base, move this minion to there as well.

sheep_black_sheep.name: Black Sheep
sheep_black_sheep.abilityText: Ongoing: After another minion is played here, move this minion to another base.

sheep_ram.name: Ram
sheep_ram.abilityText: Talent: Move this minion to another base, then you may return a minion of power 2 or less at that base to its owner's hand.

sheep_little_bo_peep.name: Little Bo Peep
sheep_little_bo_peep.abilityText: Ongoing: Other players can not move minions to or from here. Talent: Move one of your minions to here.

sheep_to_follow_or_not.name: To Follow, or Not?
sheep_to_follow_or_not.effectText: Choose another player. Choose a random action in their discard pile. Play it as an extra action or return it. Draw a card.

sheep_on_the_lamb.name: On the Lamb
sheep_on_the_lamb.effectText: Choose a base where you have a minion, and another player. Move that minion and all of that player's minions there to a single other base.

sheep_shearing.name: Shearing
sheep_shearing.effectText: Play on a minion. Draw a card. Ongoing: This minion has -2 power. At the start of your turn, return this action to your hand.

sheep_wood_for_sheep.name: Wood for Sheep
sheep_wood_for_sheep.effectText: Choose another player. Reveal a random card from their hand. You may place a card from your hand into their hand to play the revealed card. Otherwise return it and play an extra action.

sheep_ewe_shall_pass.name: Ewe Shall Pass
sheep_ewe_shall_pass.effectText: Move one of your minions to another base. Draw a card. You may play an extra action.

sheep_in_sheeps_clothing.name: In Sheep's Clothing
sheep_in_sheeps_clothing.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: After another minion moves from here to another base, you may move this minion to there as well and destroy this action.

all_stars_square_deal.name: Square Deal
all_stars_square_deal.effectText: Draw cards until at least one player has fewer cards in their hand than you.

all_stars_favor_of_dionysus.name: Favor of Dionysus
all_stars_favor_of_dionysus.effectText: One of your minions gains +1 power until the end of the turn. Play an extra action. You may place this card on top of your deck instead of the discard pile.

all_stars_gelf.name: G.E.L.F.
all_stars_gelf.abilityText: Talent: Search your deck for a non-G.E.L.F. minion of power 4 or less. Shuffle this minion into your deck and play that minion here as an extra minion.

all_stars_granny.name: Granny
all_stars_granny.abilityText: Talent: Look at the top card of your deck. Place it on the top or bottom of your deck.

all_stars_seeing_stars.name: Seeing Stars
all_stars_seeing_stars.effectText: Destroy a minion of power 3 or less.

all_stars_begin_the_summoning.name: Begin the Summoning
all_stars_begin_the_summoning.effectText: Place a minion from your discard pile on top of your deck. You may play an extra action this turn.

all_stars_ghostly_arrival.name: Ghostly Arrival
all_stars_ghostly_arrival.effectText: You may play an extra minion and/or an extra action.

all_stars_friendship_power.name: Friendship Power
all_stars_friendship_power.effectText: Move one of your minions to a base where you have a minion. You may place this action into your hand instead of the discard pile.

all_stars_non_infinite_loop.name: Non-Infinite Loop
all_stars_non_infinite_loop.effectText: Choose an action in your hand. Play it as an extra action, then you may put it back into your hand instead of the discard pile.

all_stars_full_moon.name: Full Moon
all_stars_full_moon.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Each of your minions here has +1 power.

all_stars_its_astounding.name: It's Astounding
all_stars_its_astounding.effectText: Play an action from your discard pile as an extra action.

all_stars_ensign.name: Ensign
all_stars_ensign.abilityText: Ongoing: When an opponent plays a card that directly affects one of your other minions here, you may have it affect this minion instead.

all_stars_puck.name: Puck
all_stars_puck.abilityText: Play an extra action OR draw a card.

all_stars_lab_assistant.name: Lab Assistant
all_stars_lab_assistant.abilityText: Place a +1 power counter on another one of your minions.

all_stars_prepare_for_battle.name: Prepare for Battle
all_stars_prepare_for_battle.effectText: Reveal the top two cards of your deck. Place one into your hand and the other on the bottom of your deck.

all_stars_imperial_dragon.name: Imperial Dragon
all_stars_imperial_dragon.abilityText: Ongoing: After another player plays or moves a minion here, draw a card.

all_stars_sprout.name: Sprout
all_stars_sprout.abilityText: Ongoing: Destroy this card at the start of your turn. You may search your deck for a minion of power 3 or less, and play it here as an extra minion. Shuffle your deck.

all_stars_fan.name: Fan
all_stars_fan.abilityText: Special: On your turn, you may discard this card from your hand to draw a card.

all_stars_servitor_of_cthulhu.name: Servitor of Cthulhu
all_stars_servitor_of_cthulhu.abilityText: Talent: Destroy this minion and place an action card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

base_locker_room.name: Locker Room
base_locker_room.abilityText: At the start of your turn, if you have a minion here, draw a card.

base_stadium.name: Stadium
base_stadium.abilityText: After a minion here is destroyed, its controller draws a card.

rock_stars_turn_up_to_11.name: Turn Up to 11
rock_stars_turn_up_to_11.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: If this base’s starting breakpoint is less than 21, it is increased to 21.

rock_stars_reunion_tour.name: Reunion Tour
rock_stars_reunion_tour.effectText: Shuffle any number of your minions from your discard pile into your deck.

rock_stars_total_sellout.name: Total Sellout
rock_stars_total_sellout.effectText: Special: Play after a base scores where you have a minion. Draw two cards. Draw another card if the breakpoint was 21 or higher.

rock_stars_rock_of_luuv.name: Rock of Luuv
rock_stars_rock_of_luuv.effectText: Search your deck for up to three minions with power 2 or less and the same name. Reveal them, place them into your hand and shuffle your deck.

rock_stars_guest_star.name: Guest Star
rock_stars_guest_star.effectText: Search your deck and/or discard pile for a Groupie and reveal it. Place it in your hand or play it as an extra minion. Shuffle your deck if you searched it.

rock_stars_tour_bus.name: Tour Bus
rock_stars_tour_bus.effectText: Choose a base. Move up to three of your minions from bases with lower breakpoint to there.

rock_stars_hot_venue.name: Hot Venue
rock_stars_hot_venue.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions here have +1 power. If this base has a breakpoint of 21 or higher, draw a card at the end of any turn that you play a minion here.

rock_stars_power_ballad.name: Power Ballad
rock_stars_power_ballad.effectText: Choose a base. Your minions there gain +1 power until the end of the turn. Special: If the base has a breakpoint of 21 or higher, you may play this card before the base scores.

rock_stars_the_monarch.name: The Monarch
rock_stars_the_monarch.abilityText: Talent: Search your deck and/or discard pile for a Groupie, reveal it and place it into your hand. Shuffle your deck if you searched it.

rock_stars_classic_rocker.name: Classic Rocker
rock_stars_classic_rocker.abilityText: Talent: If this base has a breakpoint of 21 or higher, draw a card. Use only one Classic Rocker ability per turn.

rock_stars_rick_roll.name: Rick Roll
rock_stars_rick_roll.abilityText: Move up to three of your minions from bases with lower breakpoints to here.

rock_stars_groupie.name: Groupie
rock_stars_groupie.abilityText: Play another Groupie here as an extra minion.

teddy_bears_square_deal.name: Square Deal
teddy_bears_square_deal.effectText: Draw cards until at least one player has fewer cards in their hand than you.

teddy_bears_love_overload.name: Love Overload
teddy_bears_love_overload.effectText: Special: Before a base scores, destroy the minion there with the most power. If tied, destroy all tied minions.

teddy_bears_group_hug.name: Group Hug
teddy_bears_group_hug.effectText: Give one of your minions +1 power for each other minion at the same base until the end of the turn.

teddy_bears_care_package.name: Care Package
teddy_bears_care_package.effectText: Draw a card and play an extra minion.

teddy_bears_too_cute.name: Too Cute
teddy_bears_too_cute.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions here cannot be destroyed by other player’s cards.

teddy_bears_bear_picnic.name: Bear Picnic
teddy_bears_bear_picnic.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Other players cannot play minions they own of power 2 or less on other bases.

teddy_bears_cuddle.name: Cuddle
teddy_bears_cuddle.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion’s abilities are cancelled.

teddy_bears_tea_party.name: Tea Party
teddy_bears_tea_party.effectText: Play on a base. Talent: If there are two or more minions here and at least one is yours, draw a card.

teddy_bears_sir_squeezes.name: Sir Squeezes
teddy_bears_sir_squeezes.abilityText: Play up to three minions of power 3 or less, whose total power is 5 or less, as extra minions here.

teddy_bears_lovey_bear.name: Lovey Bear
teddy_bears_lovey_bear.abilityText: Ongoing: This minion’s starting power is increased to the highest starting power of an opponent’s minion here.

teddy_bears_fun_bear.name: Fun Bear
teddy_bears_fun_bear.abilityText: Ongoing: After another player plays or moves a minion to here, place a +1 power counter on this minion.

teddy_bears_snuggly_bear.name: Snuggly Bear
teddy_bears_snuggly_bear.abilityText: Special: After you play your first minion in a turn, you may immediately play this minion there as an extra minion.

grannies_chicken_soup.name: Chicken Soup
grannies_chicken_soup.effectText: Place up to two cards from your discard pile on the top and/or bottom of your deck.

grannies_grannys_purse.name: Granny's Purse
grannies_grannys_purse.effectText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is an action, you may draw it or return it. Otherwise place it on the bottom of your deck. Play an extra action.

grannies_always_room_at_grannys.name: Always Room at Granny's
grannies_always_room_at_grannys.effectText: Special: Play after a base scores. Place up to three of your minions there on the top and/or bottom of your deck in any order.

grannies_matriarch.name: Matriarch
grannies_matriarch.abilityText: Talent: Reveal the bottom two cards of your deck. Draw any minions revealed, and discard the rest.

grannies_attic_treasures.name: Attic Treasures
grannies_attic_treasures.effectText: Place three cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. Draw three cards.

grannies_hush_my_stories_are_on.name: Hush, My Stories are On
grannies_hush_my_stories_are_on.effectText: Reveal the bottom card of your deck and draw it. If it is a minion you may play it as an extra minion.

grannies_family_reunion.name: Family Reunion
grannies_family_reunion.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After you play a minion here, reveal the bottom card of your deck. If it is a minion, draw it, otherwise place it on top of your deck.

grannies_dont_mess_with_my_babies.name: Don't Mess With My Babies!
grannies_dont_mess_with_my_babies.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions here cannot be affected by other players’ cards.

grannies_knitting_circle.name: Knitting Circle
grannies_knitting_circle.effectText: Destroy up to three actions played on minions and/or bases. Draw a card for each one destroyed.

grannies_granny.name: Granny
grannies_granny.abilityText: Talent: Look at the top card of your deck. Place it on the top or bottom of your deck.

grannies_nana.name: Nana
grannies_nana.abilityText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is an action, draw it or play it as an extra action. Otherwise place it on the bottom of your deck.

grannies_grandma.name: Grandma
grannies_grandma.abilityText: Look at the top card of your deck. Place it on the top or bottom of your deck.

explorers_idaho_smith.name: Idaho Smith
explorers_idaho_smith.abilityText: You may play the top base of the base deck, and move this minion and any number of your other minions from here to there.

explorers_lost_city.name: Lost City
explorers_lost_city.effectText: Special: After a base scores, reveal the top two cards of the base deck. Choose one to replace the scored base and discard the other. Play a minion on the new base as an extra minion.

explorers_you_call_this_archaeology.name: You Call This Archaeology?
explorers_you_call_this_archaeology.effectText: Move one of your minions. Special: You may play this before or after a base scores.

explorers_fortune_and_glory.name: Fortune and Glory
explorers_fortune_and_glory.effectText: Choose a base. You may move up to two minions from there to another base.

explorers_guide.name: Guide
explorers_guide.abilityText: Ongoing: After the first time each of your minions moves in a turn it gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

explorers_forgotten_horrors.name: Forgotten Horrors
explorers_forgotten_horrors.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After you play a minion here or play a card that moves your minions to here, draw a card and transfer this action to another base.

explorers_crypt_looter.name: Crypt Looter
explorers_crypt_looter.abilityText: Special: After a new base comes into play, you may play this minion on it as an extra minion.

explorers_glory_hound.name: Glory Hound
explorers_glory_hound.abilityText: Look at the top two cards of the base deck. Place one on the bottom of the deck and the other on the top.

explorers_it_belongs_in_a_museum.name: It Belongs in a Museum
explorers_it_belongs_in_a_museum.effectText: Choose two minions on different bases. Move each one to the other’s base.

explorers_i_said_no_camels.name: I Said No Camels!
explorers_i_said_no_camels.effectText: Choose a base. Place a +1 power counter on each of your minions there OR draw a card for each of your minions there.

explorers_dr_livingstone_i_presume.name: Dr Livingstone, I Presume?
explorers_dr_livingstone_i_presume.effectText: Choose a minion. If it is the only minion on its base, shuffle it into its owner’s deck.

base_under_the_bed.name: Under the Bed
base_under_the_bed.abilityText: On your turn, after one or more minions are played on other bases, you may play an extra minion of power 2 or less here.

base_out_in_the_woods.name: Out in the Woods
base_out_in_the_woods.abilityText: Before this base scores, each minion here gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

base_lake_minnetonka.name: Lake Minnetonka
base_lake_minnetonka.abilityText: After you play or move a minion to this base, that minion gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

base_palooza.name: Palooza
base_palooza.abilityText: When this base scores, each player may move one of their minions to here.

base_grandmas_house.name: Grandma's House
base_grandmas_house.abilityText: After you play a minion here, look at the top card of your deck. Put it on the top or bottom of your deck.

base_retirement_community.name: Retirement Community
base_retirement_community.abilityText: After this base scores, each player may put one of their minions here on the top or bottom of their deck.

base_ancient_temple.name: Ancient Temple
base_ancient_temple.abilityText: At the start of your turn, if you have only one minion here, that minion gains +5 power until the end of the turn.

base_city_of_gold.name: City of Gold
base_city_of_gold.abilityText: At the start of your turn, if you have a minion here, gain 1 VP.

sumo_wrestlers_technique_prize.name: Technique Prize
sumo_wrestlers_technique_prize.effectText: Place three +1 power counters on one of your minions.

sumo_wrestlers_yokozuna.name: Yokozuna
sumo_wrestlers_yokozuna.abilityText: Ongoing: Your minions cannot be moved by other players' cards. Talent: Draw a card, or move another player's minion from here to another base.

sumo_wrestlers_head_butt.name: Head Butt
sumo_wrestlers_head_butt.effectText: Choose a base where you have a minion. Destroy another player's action that has been played there or on a minion there.

sumo_wrestlers_bulking_stew.name: Bulking Stew
sumo_wrestlers_bulking_stew.effectText: Discard any number of cards. For each card discarded, place a +1 power counter on one of your minions.

sumo_wrestlers_body_slam.name: Body Slam
sumo_wrestlers_body_slam.effectText: Choose another player and a base where you have a minion. Move all of their minions there to another base.

sumo_wrestlers_chikara_mizu.name: Chikara-Mizu
sumo_wrestlers_chikara_mizu.effectText: Give one of your minions +2 power until the end of the turn, or discard a card to give it +4 power instead.

sumo_wrestlers_third_tier.name: Third Tier
sumo_wrestlers_third_tier.abilityText: You may move another player's minion of power 3 or less from here to another base to draw a card.

sumo_wrestlers_grasp_the_belt.name: Grasp the Belt
sumo_wrestlers_grasp_the_belt.effectText: Choose a base where you have a minion. Move a minion from there to another base.

sumo_wrestlers_fighting_spirit_prize.name: Fighting Spirit Prize
sumo_wrestlers_fighting_spirit_prize.effectText: Draw two cards and place two +1 power counters total on your minions.

sumo_wrestlers_top_tier.name: Top Tier
sumo_wrestlers_top_tier.abilityText: Ongoing: After you discard one or more cards from your hand, place a +1 power counter on this minion.

sumo_wrestlers_rookie_sumo.name: Rookie Sumo
sumo_wrestlers_rookie_sumo.abilityText: You may discard a card to place two +1 power counters on one of your minions.

musketeers_on_a_roll.name: On a Roll
musketeers_on_a_roll.effectText: Play up to two actions that directly affect the same minion as extra actions.

musketeers_make_way.name: Make Way
musketeers_make_way.effectText: Move one of your minions to another base. You may play an extra action.

musketeers_en_garde.name: En Garde
musketeers_en_garde.effectText: Choose a minion to gain +1 power until the end of the turn. Draw a card. You may play an extra action.

musketeers_biding_time.name: Biding Time
musketeers_biding_time.effectText: Choose a minion to gain +2 power until the end of the turn. You may play an extra action that directly affects this minion.

musketeers_to_battle.name: To Battle!
musketeers_to_battle.effectText: Play an extra minion. You may play an action that directly affects it as an extra action.

musketeers_porthos.name: Porthos
musketeers_porthos.abilityText: Ongoing: This minion is not affected by other players' actions.

musketeers_athos.name: Athos
