round_table_knights_percival.abilityText: Talent: Move this minion to another base where you have one or more actions.

round_table_knights_a_questing.name: A Questing
round_table_knights_a_questing.effectText: Play on one of your minions. You may move this minion. Ongoing: When this minion would go to the discard pile, place it on top of your deck instead.

round_table_knights_excalibur.name: Excalibur
round_table_knights_excalibur.effectText: Play on one of your minions. Ongoing: This minion gains +2 power and cannot be destroyed by other players' cards. Special: When this base scores, if this minion is King Arthur, gain 1 VP.

round_table_knights_good_deed.name: Good Deed
round_table_knights_good_deed.effectText: Play on a base. Draw a card. Ongoing: After one of your minions moves here, you may transfer this card to another base, then draw a card. Do Good's ability may only be used once per turn.

round_table_knights_merlins_library.name: Merlin's Library
round_table_knights_merlins_library.effectText: Play on a base. Talent: Play an extra minion here OR move one of your minions here OR transfer this card to another base.

round_table_knights_noble_steed.name: Noble Steed
round_table_knights_noble_steed.effectText: Play on one of your minions. Talent: Move this minion to another base.

round_table_knights_the_fisher_king.name: The Fisher King
round_table_knights_the_fisher_king.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After one or more of your minions move here, draw a card. Then if you have eight or more cards in your hand, destroy this card to gain 1 VP.

round_table_knights_the_grail.name: The Grail
round_table_knights_the_grail.effectText: Play on a base with none of your actions. Ongoing: After one of your minions moves here, if you have three or more minions of power 4 or more here, place this card in the box to gain 2 VP.

round_table_knights_the_green_knight.name: The Green Knight
round_table_knights_the_green_knight.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After one or more of your minions move here, place a +1 power counter on one of them. Then if that minion has power 7 or more, destroy this card to gain 1 VP.

round_table_knights_the_lady_of_the_lake.name: The Lady of the Lake
round_table_knights_the_lady_of_the_lake.effectText: Search your deck and/or discard pile for an action played on a minion. Draw it or play it as an extra action.

round_table_knights_the_mists_of_avalon.name: The Mists of Avalon
round_table_knights_the_mists_of_avalon.effectText: Shuffle up to three minions from your discard pile into your deck.

round_table_knights_the_questing_beast.name: The Questing Beast
round_table_knights_the_questing_beast.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After one or more of your minions move here, place a +1 power counter on one of them, then transfer this card to another base.

base_camelot.name: Camelot
base_camelot.abilityText: Minions here with printed power 4 or more cannot be affected by other players' cards. On your turn, you may move one of your minions from here to another base.

base_round_table.name: Round Table
base_round_table.abilityText: Each of your minions here with the same printed power as another one of your minions here has +1 power.

goblins_chaos_lord.name: Chaos Lord
goblins_chaos_lord.abilityText: Ongoing: After you flip a coin, if it is heads, place a +1 power counter on one of your minions; if it is tails, draw a card, then discard a card.

goblins_diviner.name: Diviner
goblins_diviner.abilityText: Ongoing: Once per turn, after you flip a coin, you may immediately discard a card to change the result. After the first time you flip a coin each turn, draw a card.

goblins_blaster.name: Blaster
goblins_blaster.abilityText: Special: Before this base scores, flip a coin. If it is heads, you may give this minion +2 power until the end of the turn. If it is tails, you may move this minion to another base.

goblins_gobbo.name: Gobbo
goblins_gobbo.abilityText: Flip a coin for each Gobbo in play, including this one. For each heads, place a +1 power counter on this minion.

goblins_magic_helmet.name: "Magic" Helmet
goblins_magic_helmet.effectText: Play on your minion. Ongoing: This minion gains +4 power. Before this base scores, flip a coin. If it is tails, destroy this minion.

goblins_a_little_help.name: A Little Help
goblins_a_little_help.effectText: Flip a coin. If it is heads, you may play an extra minion. If it is tails, you may play two extra actions.

goblins_bushwhacking.name: Bushwhacking
goblins_bushwhacking.effectText: Choose a minion, then flip a coin. If it is heads, destroy this minion. If it is tails, move it to another base.

goblins_demolition.name: Demolition
goblins_demolition.effectText: Flip three coins. For each heads, place a +1 power counter on one of your minions. For each tails, you may destroy an action on a base or minion.

goblins_recruiters.name: Goblin Recruiters
goblins_recruiters.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After you flip a coin, if it is heads, draw a card; if it is tails, you may shuffle a card from your discard pile into your deck.

goblins_he_who_smelt_it.name: He Who Smelt It
goblins_he_who_smelt_it.effectText: Choose a minion, then flip a coin. If it is heads, place a +1 power counter on that minion, then you may choose another minion and flip again. If it is tails, you may play an extra action.

goblins_make_your_own_luck.name: Make Your Own Luck
goblins_make_your_own_luck.effectText: Special: Play immediately after you flip a coin. Change the result.

goblins_revving_up.name: Revving Up
goblins_revving_up.effectText: Choose a base. For each of your minions there, flip a coin. For each heads, place a +1 power counter on that minion. For each tails, that minion gains +2 power until the end of the turn.

base_goblin_caves.name: Goblin Caves
base_goblin_caves.abilityText: After this base scores, each player with a minion there may flip a coin. If it is heads, they gain 1 VP. If it is tails, they discard two cards.

base_goblin_town.name: Goblin Town
base_goblin_town.abilityText: After you play a minion here, flip a coin. If it is heads, place a +1 power counter on that minion.

geckos_hokusai.name: Hokusai
geckos_hokusai.abilityText: You may place a +1 power counter on one of your minions. Talent: If you have played at least two actions this turn, for each base you may place a +1 power counter on a minion there.

geckos_kandinsky.name: Kandinsky
geckos_kandinsky.abilityText: This minion gains +1 power until the end of the turn. Talent: If you have played at least two actions this turn, give this minion +2 power until the end of the turn OR move another one of your minions to here.

geckos_monet.name: Monet
geckos_monet.abilityText: Draw a card. Ongoing: Any time you can play an action, you may instead draw a card and trigger all abilities as though you had played an action.

geckos_van_gogh.name: Van Gogh
geckos_van_gogh.abilityText: You may shuffle a standard action from your discard pile into your deck. Ongoing: After you play a standard action, you may store it under this card. At the start of your turn or after you win this base, shuffle all cards stored under this card into your deck.

geckos_june.name: June
geckos_june.abilityText: If you have a minion of printed power 4 in play, you may swap it for one with a different name in your hand or deck; if not, you may draw one off the top of your deck.

geckos_breaking_news.name: Breaking News
geckos_breaking_news.effectText: Look at the top four cards of your deck. Draw one and return the rest in any order. If this is your first action played this turn, play an extra action.

geckos_flip_kick.name: Flip Kick
geckos_flip_kick.effectText: Draw a card. If this is your first action played this turn, play an extra action; if not, draw two more cards.

geckos_gecko_blimp.name: Gecko Blimp
geckos_gecko_blimp.effectText: If this is your first action played this turn, move one of your minions and play an extra action; if not, move any minion.

geckos_gecko_power.name: Gecko Power
geckos_gecko_power.effectText: Play on a minion. Talent: If you have played at least two other actions this turn, move this minion OR place a +1 power counter on it OR give it +2 power until the end of the turn.

geckos_gecko_rap.name: Gecko Rap
geckos_gecko_rap.effectText: Swap one of your minions in play for one with a different name and equal or less power in your hand, deck or discard pile. If this is your first action played this turn, play an extra action; if not, place a +1 power counter on the new minion.

geckos_lasagna_party.name: Lasagna Party
geckos_lasagna_party.effectText: Play an extra minion of power 2 or less. If this is your first action played this turn, play an extra action; if not, place two +1 power counters on a minion at that base.

geckos_now_you_know_bullying.name: Now You Know: Bullying
geckos_now_you_know_bullying.effectText: Move one of your minions. Special: After a base scores where you didn't win, you may play this card to return one of your minions there to your hand instead.

geckos_masters_teachings.name: The Master's Teachings
geckos_masters_teachings.effectText: Place two +1 power counters on one of your minions. If this is your first action played this turn, play an extra action; if not, you may give that minion +2 power until the end of the turn.

geckos_kc_smith.name: K.C. Smith
geckos_kc_smith.abilityText: Minion: Play an extra action.|Action: Play an extra minion.

gi_gerald_viscount.name: Viscount
gi_gerald_viscount.abilityText: Ongoing: Once per turn, after you play a fusion and use its Action ability, you may give this minion +2 power until the end of the turn OR place a +1 power counter on it.

gi_gerald_go_gerald.name: Go, Gerald!
gi_gerald_go_gerald.effectText: Choose a base. Give each of your minions played there this turn +2 power until the end of the turn.

gi_gerald_now_you_know_home_safety.name: Now You Know: Home Safety
gi_gerald_now_you_know_home_safety.effectText: Play an extra minion of power 2 or less. If it is a fusion, you may also use its Action ability. Special: You may play this before a base scores to copy the Action ability of one of your fusions there instead.

gi_gerald_mowat.name: M.O.W.A.T.
gi_gerald_mowat.abilityText: Minion: You may give another minion +1 power until the end of the turn.|Action: Give a minion +3 power until the end of the turn.

gi_gerald_obstruction.name: Obstruction
gi_gerald_obstruction.abilityText: Minion: Each of your minions here gains +1 power until the end of the turn.|Action: Place a minion of power 3 or less on the bottom of its owner's deck.

gi_gerald_sawbones.name: Sawbones
gi_gerald_sawbones.abilityText: Minion: Shuffle an action from your discard pile into your deck.|Action: Shuffle a minion from your discard pile into your deck.

gi_gerald_ski_lift.name: Ski Lift
gi_gerald_ski_lift.abilityText: Minion: You may move one of your minions from another base to here.|Action: Move a minion.

gi_gerald_can_do.name: Can-Do
gi_gerald_can_do.abilityText: Minion: You may play an extra minion of power 2 or less here, or an extra action.|Action: You may play an extra minion of power 2 or less, and an extra action.

gi_gerald_mabel_lean.name: Mabel Lean
gi_gerald_mabel_lean.abilityText: Minion: If this is your only minion here, you may place a +1 power counter on it.|Action: Play an extra minion of power 2 or less.

gi_gerald_shellback.name: Shellback
gi_gerald_shellback.abilityText: Minion: You may return one of your non-Shellback fusions to your hand.|Action: Copy the Action ability on one of your other fusions in play.

gi_gerald_dice_ninja.name: Dice Ninja
gi_gerald_dice_ninja.abilityText: Minion: Draw a card.|Action: Draw two cards.

gi_gerald_rosie.name: Rosie
gi_gerald_rosie.abilityText: Minion: You may place a +1 power counter on another minion here.|Action: Place two +1 power counters total on your minions.

rulers_cosmos_gal_woman.name: Gal-Woman
rulers_cosmos_gal_woman.abilityText: Talent: Play an extra play-on-minion action from any player's discard pile. At the end of the turn, or when it leaves play, place it on the bottom of its owner's deck.

rulers_cosmos_guy_man.name: Guy-Man
rulers_cosmos_guy_man.abilityText: Talent: Copy the talent of another one of your minions.

rulers_cosmos_andko.name: Andko
rulers_cosmos_andko.abilityText: Talent: Play an extra action on a minion that does not have one on it.

rulers_cosmos_man_with_arms.name: Man with Arms
rulers_cosmos_man_with_arms.abilityText: Talent: If this minion has an action on it, it gains +2 power until the start of your next turn. Ongoing: Once per turn, when this minion would use a talent given by an action, it may instead use another of its talents an extra time.

rulers_cosmos_frogga.name: Frogga
rulers_cosmos_frogga.abilityText: Draw a play-on-minion action off the top of your deck. Ongoing: When this minion leaves play, you may shuffle an action on it into your deck.

rulers_cosmos_young_noble.name: Young Noble
rulers_cosmos_young_noble.abilityText: Talent: If a Sword card is on this minion, swap this minion for a minion of power 5 or more from your hand, deck, or discard pile.

rulers_cosmos_armor_of_battle.name: Armor of Battle
rulers_cosmos_armor_of_battle.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion has the ability: "Talent: Increase the breakpoint of this base by 2 for each of your minions here with an action on it until the start of your next turn."

rulers_cosmos_dolts_halfwits_fools_moron.name: Dolts, Halfwits, Fools, Morons!
rulers_cosmos_dolts_halfwits_fools_moron.effectText: Transfer any number of actions on your minions to your other minions. Place a +1 power counter on each of your minions you transferred an action to.

rulers_cosmos_fearless_friend.name: Fearless Friend
rulers_cosmos_fearless_friend.effectText: Play on your minion. Ongoing: This minion has the ability: "Talent: Move this minion."

rulers_cosmos_magic_weapon.name: Magic Weapon
rulers_cosmos_magic_weapon.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion has the ability: "Talent: This minion gains +1 power until the start of your next turn for each player with a minion here OR if there is only one action on this minion, draw a card."

rulers_cosmos_myaaah.name: MYAAAH!
rulers_cosmos_myaaah.effectText: Return a play-on-minion action from one of your minions or from your discard pile to its owner's hand. Play it as an extra action.

rulers_cosmos_mystic_transference.name: Mystic Transference
rulers_cosmos_mystic_transference.effectText: Play on your minion. Ongoing: At the start of each other player's turn, choose one of your actions in play that gives a talent. This minion may copy that talent immediately. Talent: Transfer one of your actions between this minion and another of your minions.

rulers_cosmos_now_you_know_toxic_waste.name: Now You Know: Toxic Waste
rulers_cosmos_now_you_know_toxic_waste.effectText: Draw a play-on-minion action from your deck. Special: You may play this before a base scores to transfer an action from one of your minions to another instead; then you may use a talent on the minion the action was transferred to.

rulers_cosmos_powerful_sword.name: Powerful Sword
rulers_cosmos_powerful_sword.effectText: Play on your minion. Ongoing: This minion has the ability: "Talent: This minion is not affected by other players' cards until the start of your next turn." Talent: Transfer another action from this minion to another of your minions.

rulers_cosmos_sword_thats_powerful.name: Sword That's Powerful
rulers_cosmos_sword_thats_powerful.effectText: Play on your minion. Ongoing: This minion has the ability: "Talent: Place a +1 power counter on this minion." If this minion's printed power is 5 or more, it has +2 power.

pearl_images_pearl.name: Pearl
pearl_images_pearl.abilityText: Talent: Draw a minion of power 2 or less off the top of your deck OR give a minion here +1 power until the end of the turn.

pearl_images_crystal.name: Crystal
pearl_images_crystal.abilityText: Talent: Place a +1 power counter on another player's minion to place a +1 power counter on one of your minions at the same base.

pearl_images_ruby.name: Ruby
pearl_images_ruby.abilityText: You may give all players' minions here +1 power until the end of the turn.

pearl_images_topaz.name: Topaz
pearl_images_topaz.abilityText: Ongoing: Once per turn, after the power of another player's minion increases, you may place a +1 power counter on this minion OR if you have a minion there, you may move this minion to there.

pearl_images_alls_right_with_the_world.name: All's Right with the World
pearl_images_alls_right_with_the_world.effectText: Play on a base. Talent: Give all players' minions here +1 power until the end of the turn OR for each player, give one of their minions here +2 power until the end of the turn.

pearl_images_dressing_room.name: Dressing Room
pearl_images_dressing_room.effectText: Each player may draw a card. Draw a card for each player who does so, including yourself.

pearl_images_jam_all_night_long.name: Jam All Night Long
pearl_images_jam_all_night_long.effectText: Play on a base. Talent: Choose a player to play an extra minion of power 2 or less here or reveal a hand with no such minions. Then, if you chose another player and they played a minion, you may draw a card or place a +1 power counter on a minion here.

pearl_images_love_unites_us.name: Love Unites Us
pearl_images_love_unites_us.effectText: All players shuffle all minions of power 2 or less in their discard pile into their deck.

pearl_images_now_you_know_bike_safety.name: Now You Know: Bike Safety
pearl_images_now_you_know_bike_safety.effectText: Choose one of your minions on a base. Move that minion and another player's minion there to another base. Special: You may play this before a base scores; move the chosen minions to the scoring base.

pearl_images_shes_got_the_power.name: She's Got the Power
pearl_images_shes_got_the_power.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: Once per turn, after the power of another player's minion here increases, you may give this minion +3 power until the end of the turn.

pearl_images_truly_outstanding.name: Truly Outstanding
pearl_images_truly_outstanding.effectText: Place a +1 power counter on any number of other players' minions. For each one placed, you may place a +1 power counter on one of your minions.

pearl_images_were_up_youre_down.name: We're Up, You're Down
pearl_images_were_up_youre_down.effectText: Choose a base. Until the start of your next turn, other players' minions there only add their printed power to their controllers' total. Special: You may play this before a base scores where you have the most minions. You must choose that base.

base_sewer_hideout.name: Sewer Hideout
base_sewer_hideout.abilityText: After your second action in a turn, you may place a +1 power counter on a minion here.

base_technoball.name: Technoball
base_technoball.abilityText: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may play an extra action.

base_gi_geralds_base.name: G.I. Gerald's Base
base_gi_geralds_base.abilityText: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, you may draw a card and place a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.

base_uss_banner.name: USS Banner
base_uss_banner.abilityText: On your turn, you may play an extra minion here of power 2 or less. If you control it at the end of the turn, place it on top of your deck.

base_power_castle.name: Power Castle
base_power_castle.abilityText: Once per turn, after an action is played on or transferred to a minion here, you may place a +1 power counter on that minion.

base_slime_pool.name: Slime Pool
base_slime_pool.abilityText: Instead of your regular action play, you may play a play-on-minion action off the top of your deck on a minion here.

base_concert_venue.name: Concert Venue
base_concert_venue.abilityText: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may place a +1 power counter on it.

base_recording_studio.name: Recording Studio
base_recording_studio.abilityText: At the start of each turn, all players' minions here gain +1 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_dwarves_dwarf_king.name: Dwarf King
munchkin_dwarves_dwarf_king.abilityText: Ongoing: When a Treasure card on one of your minions would go to the discard pile, place it into your hand instead.

munchkin_dwarves_loot_lover.name: Loot Lover
munchkin_dwarves_loot_lover.abilityText: Ongoing: This minion gains +2 power for each Treasure card on it.

munchkin_dwarves_gold_digger.name: Gold Digger
munchkin_dwarves_gold_digger.abilityText: Talent: Place a Treasure card from the discard pile into your hand.

munchkin_dwarves_gem_grabber.name: Gem Grabber
munchkin_dwarves_gem_grabber.abilityText: Ongoing: If this minion has a Treasure card on it, it gains +2 power.

munchkin_halflings_shire_marshal.name: Shire Marshal
munchkin_halflings_shire_marshal.abilityText: Talent: Play an extra minion on a base where another player has more power than you.

munchkin_halflings_pestling.name: Pestling
munchkin_halflings_pestling.abilityText: You may play an extra minion here.

munchkin_halflings_bardling.name: Bardling
munchkin_halflings_bardling.abilityText: If another player has more power than you here, you may play an extra minion here.

munchkin_halflings_quarterling.name: Quarterling
munchkin_halflings_quarterling.abilityText: If this is your only minion here, you may play an extra minion here.

munchkin_thieves_fence.name: Fence
munchkin_thieves_fence.abilityText: You may discard two Treasure cards to gain 1 VP.

munchkin_thieves_cat_burglar.name: Cat Burglar
munchkin_thieves_cat_burglar.abilityText: Reveal any number of Treasure cards from your hand. For each card revealed, place a +1 power counter on this minion.

munchkin_thieves_pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
munchkin_thieves_pickpocket.abilityText: If there is another Pickpocket here, draw a Treasure card.

munchkin_mages_blaster_master.name: Blaster Master
munchkin_mages_blaster_master.abilityText: Talent: Discard a card to destroy a minion of power 2 or less.

munchkin_mages_happy_zapper.name: Happy Zapper
munchkin_mages_happy_zapper.abilityText: Talent: Discard a card to give this minion +2 power until the end of the turn. Special: Before this base scores, you may use this minion's talent.

munchkin_mages_wand_whiz.name: Wand Whiz
munchkin_mages_wand_whiz.abilityText: You may discard a card to play an extra minion or play an extra action.

munchkin_mages_scroll_shuffler.name: Scroll Shuffler
munchkin_mages_scroll_shuffler.abilityText: Discard a card. Draw a card.

munchkin_elves_fae_fighter.name: Fae Fighter
munchkin_elves_fae_fighter.abilityText: Ongoing: After another player plays a minion, you may place a +1 power counter on it to place a +1 power counter on one of your minions here.

munchkin_elves_lord_of_the_prance.name: Lord of the Prance
munchkin_elves_lord_of_the_prance.abilityText: Talent: You choose another player to draw a card. Draw a card.

munchkin_elves_flower_child.name: Flower Child
munchkin_elves_flower_child.abilityText: You may give control of this minion to another player until it leaves play to control one of that player's minions of power 3 or less until it leaves play.

munchkin_elves_elf_help_guru.name: Elf Help Guru
munchkin_elves_elf_help_guru.abilityText: Talent: All other players' minions here gain +1 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_clerics_cardinal.name: Cardinal
munchkin_clerics_cardinal.abilityText: Talent: If your discard pile has at least five cards, randomly place two of them into your hand.

munchkin_clerics_deep_friar.name: Deep Friar
munchkin_clerics_deep_friar.abilityText: Special: After this base scores, you may move another of your minions here to another base instead of it going to the discard pile.

munchkin_clerics_turner.name: Turner
munchkin_clerics_turner.abilityText: Destroy an Undead Monster here, or shuffle a random minion from your discard pile into your deck.

munchkin_clerics_holy_roller.name: Holy Roller
munchkin_clerics_holy_roller.abilityText: You may shuffle a random card from your discard pile into your deck.

munchkin_orcs_sword_lord.name: Sword Lord
munchkin_orcs_sword_lord.abilityText: Ongoing: Each of your other minions gains +1 power.

munchkin_orcs_hammer_slammer.name: Hammer Slammer
munchkin_orcs_hammer_slammer.abilityText: Destroy a minion of power 2 or less.

munchkin_orcs_dork_orc.name: Dork Orc
munchkin_orcs_dork_orc.abilityText: Ongoing: This minion is not affected by other players' actions.

munchkin_warriors_big_hero.name: Big Hero
munchkin_warriors_big_hero.abilityText: Talent: Destroy a monster here OR play a monster here.

munchkin_warriors_star_player.name: Star Player
munchkin_warriors_star_player.abilityText: Ongoing: After a monster is destroyed here, place a +1 power counter on this minion.

munchkin_warriors_berserker.name: Berserker
munchkin_warriors_berserker.abilityText: Destroy a monster here with power less than or equal to this minion's power to place a +1 power counter on this minion.

munchkin_warriors_taunter.name: Taunter
munchkin_warriors_taunter.abilityText: You may play a monster here.

munchkin_dwarves_anything_for_money.name: Anything for Money
munchkin_dwarves_anything_for_money.effectText: Discard any number of cards. For each card discarded, draw a Treasure card.

munchkin_dwarves_cash_out.name: Cash Out
munchkin_dwarves_cash_out.effectText: Play up to three Treasure cards from your hand as extra cards.

munchkin_dwarves_cunning_plan.name: Cunning Plan
munchkin_dwarves_cunning_plan.effectText: Special: Before a base scores, play this. Draw a Treasure card. You may play it.

munchkin_dwarves_greed_is_good.name: Greed is Good
munchkin_dwarves_greed_is_good.effectText: Draw a Treasure card OR place a Treasure card from the discard pile into your hand. You may play an extra action.

munchkin_dwarves_hidden_assets.name: Hidden Assets
munchkin_dwarves_hidden_assets.effectText: Place the top three cards of the Treasure deck into the discard pile. Draw a card. You may play an extra action.

munchkin_dwarves_mine.name: Mine!
munchkin_dwarves_mine.effectText: Search the Treasure deck for a card that can be played on a minion. Play it on one of your minions as an extra action. Shuffle the Treasure deck.

munchkin_dwarves_no_my_precious.name: No! My Precious!
munchkin_dwarves_no_my_precious.effectText: Destroy an action played on a minion. If it is a Treasure card, you may play an extra action.

munchkin_dwarves_salvage.name: Salvage
munchkin_dwarves_salvage.effectText: Special: Before a base scores, play this. Play a Treasure card from the discard pile on one of your minions there.

munchkin_treasure_halfling_hireling.name: Halfling Hireling
munchkin_treasure_halfling_hireling.abilityText: After you play this minion, you may play an extra minion this turn. That extra minion may be a Treasure minion.

munchkin_treasure_bag_of_caltrops.name: Bag of Caltrops
munchkin_treasure_bag_of_caltrops.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After another player plays a minion of power 3 or less here, destroy that minion and destroy this card.

munchkin_treasure_spiky_boots.name: Spiky Boots
munchkin_treasure_spiky_boots.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion gains +1 power.

munchkin_treasure_rocket_boots.name: Rocket Boots
munchkin_treasure_rocket_boots.effectText: Play on a minion. Talent: Move this minion to another base. This card stays on it.

munchkin_treasure_buckler_of_swashing.name: Buckler of Swashing
munchkin_treasure_buckler_of_swashing.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion cannot be destroyed.

munchkin_treasure_bloody_dismemberment_c.name: Bloody Dismemberment Chainsaw
munchkin_treasure_bloody_dismemberment_c.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion gains +2 power.

munchkin_treasure_loads_of_treasure.name: Loads of Treasure
munchkin_treasure_loads_of_treasure.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion gains +1 power for each Treasure card on it.

munchkin_treasure_crossbow.name: Crossbow
munchkin_treasure_crossbow.effectText: Choose a base and a faction. Until the end of the turn, all minions of that faction there gain +2 power.

munchkin_treasure_dungeon_rulebook.name: Dungeon Rulebook
munchkin_treasure_dungeon_rulebook.effectText: Destroy an action played on a minion or on a base. Special: You may play this before a base scores.

munchkin_treasure_temporal_displacement_.name: Temporal Displacement Jetpack
munchkin_treasure_temporal_displacement_.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: When this minion would go from a base to the discard pile, place it into your hand instead. Then place this card into the discard pile.

munchkin_treasure_kneepads_of_allure.name: Kneepads of Allure
munchkin_treasure_kneepads_of_allure.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: Each minion here gains +1 power.

munchkin_treasure_magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
munchkin_treasure_magic_missile.effectText: Play on a minion. Talent: Destroy a minion of power 3 or less here. Place this card on the bottom of the Treasure deck.

munchkin_treasure_potion_of_cowardice.name: Potion of Cowardice
munchkin_treasure_potion_of_cowardice.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion gains -2 power and loses all abilities.

munchkin_treasure_potion_of_halitosis.name: Potion of Halitosis
munchkin_treasure_potion_of_halitosis.effectText: Choose a base and a player. That player must move one of their minions there to another base. Special: You may play this before a base scores. You must choose the scoring base.

munchkin_treasure_potion_of_idiotic_brav.name: Potion of Idiotic Bravery
munchkin_treasure_potion_of_idiotic_brav.effectText: Choose a minion. It gains +3 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_treasure_potion_of_straight_lin.name: Potion of Straight Line Running Away
munchkin_treasure_potion_of_straight_lin.effectText: Special: After a base scores, play this. Choose one of the revealed undistributed Treasure cards and place it into your hand.

munchkin_treasure_potion_of_paralysis.name: Potion of Paralysis
munchkin_treasure_potion_of_paralysis.effectText: Special: You may play this before a base scores. Until the end of the turn, cancel the abilities of all cards and minions on the scoring base.

munchkin_treasure_potion_of_duplication.name: Potion of Duplication
munchkin_treasure_potion_of_duplication.effectText: Play on a minion. Talent: Choose another minion with a Talent. This minion uses that Talent and pays any costs for it.

munchkin_treasure_treasure_finder.name: Treasure Finder
munchkin_treasure_treasure_finder.effectText: Draw two Treasure cards. Shuffle this card and the Treasure discard pile into the Treasure deck.

munchkin_treasure_wishing_ring.name: Wishing Ring
munchkin_treasure_wishing_ring.effectText: Gain 1 VP. Place this card on the bottom of the Treasure deck.

munchkin_halflings_last_call.name: Last Call
munchkin_halflings_last_call.effectText: Special: Before a base scores, play this. Play a minion there. Cancel that minion's abilities until the end of the turn.

munchkin_halflings_lunch_run.name: Lunch Run
munchkin_halflings_lunch_run.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After each time you play a minion here, draw a card.

munchkin_halflings_out_of_nowhere.name: Out Of Nowhere
munchkin_halflings_out_of_nowhere.effectText: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal two minions. Place those minions into your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.

munchkin_halflings_rude_awakening.name: Rude Awakening
munchkin_halflings_rude_awakening.effectText: Choose a base. Reveal your hand, then play all minions from it on that base as extra minions. Cancel their abilities until the end of the turn.

munchkin_halflings_small_but_tough.name: Small But Tough
munchkin_halflings_small_but_tough.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: When this minion would go to the discard pile, place it on top of your deck instead.

munchkin_halflings_sneaksy.name: Sneaksy
munchkin_halflings_sneaksy.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions here are not affected by other players' actions.

munchkin_halflings_spoiled_brats.name: Spoiled Brats
munchkin_halflings_spoiled_brats.effectText: Choose any number of minions from your discard pile, shuffle them, then place them on top of your deck.

munchkin_halflings_unexpected_party.name: Unexpected Party
munchkin_halflings_unexpected_party.effectText: Play an extra minion on a base where you have no minions.

munchkin_thieves_backstab.name: Backstab
munchkin_thieves_backstab.effectText: Discard a Treasure card to destroy a minion of power 3 or less.

munchkin_thieves_clever_distraction.name: Clever Distraction
munchkin_thieves_clever_distraction.effectText: Special: After a base scores, play this if you have a minion there. The winner loses 1 VP, then you gain 1 VP.

munchkin_thieves_mugging.name: Mugging
munchkin_thieves_mugging.effectText: Transfer an action played on a minion to one of your minions.

munchkin_thieves_potion_bandolier.name: Potion Bandolier
munchkin_thieves_potion_bandolier.effectText: Choose a minion. Discard a Treasure card to give that minion +3 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_thieves_secret_stash.name: Secret Stash
munchkin_thieves_secret_stash.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: When this base scores, add two Treasure cards to the rewards.

munchkin_thieves_smuggling.name: Smuggling
munchkin_thieves_smuggling.effectText: Discard two Treasure cards to gain 1 VP. Shuffle your discard pile into your deck. Place this card on the bottom of your deck.

munchkin_thieves_strip_bare.name: Strip Bare
munchkin_thieves_strip_bare.effectText: Choose a Treasure card in play. Place it into your hand.

munchkin_mages_charm.name: Charm
munchkin_mages_charm.effectText: Control a monster, then treat it as your minion until the end of the turn.

munchkin_mages_embiggen.name: Embiggen
munchkin_mages_embiggen.effectText: Choose a minion. Discard any number of cards. For each card discarded, this minion gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_mages_mass_summoning.name: Mass Summoning
munchkin_mages_mass_summoning.effectText: Play a monster on each base.

munchkin_mages_portal_to_beyond.name: Portal to Beyond
munchkin_mages_portal_to_beyond.effectText: Play on a base. Talent: Discard a card to play a monster here.

munchkin_mages_recover_arcane_wisdom.name: Recover Arcane Wisdom
munchkin_mages_recover_arcane_wisdom.effectText: Draw cards until you have five cards in your hand.

munchkin_mages_some_enchanted_evening.name: Some Enchanted Evening
munchkin_mages_some_enchanted_evening.effectText: Discard any number of cards. For each card discarded, you may play a minion of power 3 or less as an extra minion.

munchkin_mages_speed_reading.name: Speed Reading
munchkin_mages_speed_reading.effectText: Discard a card. Draw three cards.

munchkin_mages_zzzzzap.name: Zzzzzap!
munchkin_mages_zzzzzap.effectText: Discard a card to destroy a minion of power 3 or less.

munchkin_elves_after_you.name: After You
munchkin_elves_after_you.effectText: Each other player draws a card. Draw a card for each player in the game, including yourself.

munchkin_elves_dancing_root.name: Dancing Root
munchkin_elves_dancing_root.effectText: All players shuffle their discard piles into their decks. Draw a card.

munchkin_elves_helping_hands.name: Helping Hands
munchkin_elves_helping_hands.effectText: Special: Play before a base where you have a minion scores. Choose another player. That player gains a total of +2 power; one of your minions gets -2 power (minimum 0). If that player is the winner, you may gain 1 VP from that player.

munchkin_elves_pumping_iron.name: Pumping Iron
munchkin_elves_pumping_iron.effectText: Choose another player. That player chooses a minion to get +2 power until the end of the turn. You choose a minion to get +3 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_elves_run_away.name: Run Away!
munchkin_elves_run_away.effectText: Special: Play before a base where you have a minion scores. Move one of your minions and another player's minion from there to another base.

munchkin_elves_run_away_more.name: Run Away More!
munchkin_elves_run_away_more.effectText: Special: Play before a base scores. Move any number of your minions from there to another base.

munchkin_elves_trade.name: Trade
munchkin_elves_trade.effectText: Randomly draw a card from another player's hand and put it into your hand, then put this card into that player's hand. You may play an extra action this turn.

munchkin_elves_traveling_elf.name: Traveling Elf
munchkin_elves_traveling_elf.effectText: Play on one of your minions. Talent: Move this minion to another base.

munchkin_clerics_bin_and_gone.name: Bin and Gone
munchkin_clerics_bin_and_gone.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After another base scores, you may move one of your minions there to here instead of the discard pile.

munchkin_clerics_collection_plate.name: Collection Plate
munchkin_clerics_collection_plate.effectText: Place two random cards from your discard pile into your hand.

munchkin_clerics_curse_of_imprisonment.name: Curse of Imprisonment
munchkin_clerics_curse_of_imprisonment.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion loses its abilities.

munchkin_clerics_curse_of_uselessness.name: Curse of Uselessness
munchkin_clerics_curse_of_uselessness.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion does not add its power to this base.

munchkin_clerics_good_habits.name: Good Habits
munchkin_clerics_good_habits.effectText: All minions gain +1 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_clerics_join_the_club.name: Join the Club
munchkin_clerics_join_the_club.effectText: Choose a base. All minions there gain +1 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_clerics_remove_curse.name: Remove Curse
munchkin_clerics_remove_curse.effectText: Destroy an action on a base or on a minion.

munchkin_clerics_word_of_recall.name: Word of Recall
munchkin_clerics_word_of_recall.effectText: Randomly choose an action from each other player's discard pile. You may play one of them as an extra action. Return the rest.

munchkin_orcs_and_stay_down.name: And Stay Down!
munchkin_orcs_and_stay_down.effectText: Special: Before a base scores, play this. If you have the highest total power here, other players cannot play or use Special abilities.

munchkin_orcs_angry_pillagers.name: Angry Pillagers
munchkin_orcs_angry_pillagers.effectText: Special: When a base scores, play this. If you have at least 3 more power than second place, gain 1 VP.

munchkin_orcs_crush.name: Crush
munchkin_orcs_crush.effectText: Choose a base and a player who has fewer minions there than you do. Destroy one of that player's minions there.

munchkin_orcs_death_breath.name: Death Breath
munchkin_orcs_death_breath.effectText: Place a minion of power 4 or less on the bottom of its owner's deck.

munchkin_orcs_dogpile.name: Dogpile
munchkin_orcs_dogpile.effectText: Move one of your minions to a base where you have at least two minions. Special: You may play this before a base scores.

munchkin_orcs_gimme.name: Gimme!
munchkin_orcs_gimme.effectText: Choose an action on a minion. Destroy that minion, then transfer that action to one of your minions.

munchkin_orcs_stalling.name: Stalling
munchkin_orcs_stalling.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Whenever another player plays a card, you may choose that your minions here are not affected by it.

munchkin_orcs_too_tough.name: Too Tough
munchkin_orcs_too_tough.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion is not affected by other players' actions.

munchkin_warriors_campaign.name: Campaign
munchkin_warriors_campaign.effectText: Your minions on each base that has a monster gain +2 power until the end of the turn.

munchkin_warriors_cleave.name: Cleave
munchkin_warriors_cleave.effectText: Destroy a monster. You may play any number of Treasure cards gained from destroying it as extra cards.

munchkin_warriors_dumbbells.name: Dumbbells
munchkin_warriors_dumbbells.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion gains +3 power.

munchkin_warriors_dungeon_bait.name: Dungeon Bait
munchkin_warriors_dungeon_bait.effectText: Play a monster on a base OR destroy a minion of power 2 or less.

munchkin_warriors_eternal_hero.name: Eternal Hero
munchkin_warriors_eternal_hero.effectText: Play on one of your minions. Ongoing: When this minion would go to the discard pile, place it and this action into your hand instead.

munchkin_warriors_ruckus.name: Ruckus
munchkin_warriors_ruckus.effectText: Choose a base. Play two monsters there OR destroy all monsters there without gaining any Treasure cards.

munchkin_warriors_shield_of_ubiquity.name: Shield of Ubiquity
munchkin_warriors_shield_of_ubiquity.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion gains +2 power for each monster here.

munchkin_warriors_war_cry.name: War Cry
munchkin_warriors_war_cry.effectText: Destroy a monster to add its power to a minion on that base until the end of the turn.

base_the_mines.name: The Mines
base_the_mines.abilityText: Each minion here gains +1 power for each Treasure on it.

base_treasure_bath.name: Treasure Bath
base_treasure_bath.abilityText: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, draw a Treasure card.

base_birthday_party.name: Birthday Party
base_birthday_party.abilityText: 1 Monster. If you have no minions here, you cannot play minions on another base.

base_subterranean_lair.name: Subterranean Lair
base_subterranean_lair.abilityText: 1 Monster. On your turn, if you have no minions at this base, you may play an extra minion here.

base_the_coffers.name: The Coffers
base_the_coffers.abilityText: 2 Monsters. When this base scores, each player with a minion here draws a Treasure card.

base_thieves_guild.name: Thieves' Guild
base_thieves_guild.abilityText: 1 Monster. After you play a Treasure card on this base or on a minion on this base, draw a card.

base_dimension_doors.name: Dimension Doors
base_dimension_doors.abilityText: 1 Monster. After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may discard a card to play an extra minion here.

base_mages_tower.name: Mage's Tower
base_mages_tower.abilityText: 1 Monster. After you play a minion here, you may draw a card.

base_helpers_hollow.name: Helper's Hollow
base_helpers_hollow.abilityText: 2 Monsters. During each player's turn, other players' minions here gain +1 power.

base_treehouse.name: Treehouse
base_treehouse.abilityText: 2 Monsters. After you play a minion here, choose another player. That player may draw a card.

base_hotel_of_holiness.name: Hotel of Holiness
base_hotel_of_holiness.abilityText: 2 Monsters. After this base scores, place the minions here on top of their owners' decks in any order instead of the discard pile.

base_whack_a_ghoul.name: Whack-A-Ghoul
base_whack_a_ghoul.abilityText: 3 Monsters. After an Undead Monster is played here, place it on the bottom of the monster deck.

base_garrison.name: Garrison
base_garrison.abilityText: When this base scores, if all players have 22 or more total power here, the top three players by power each gain 1 VP.

base_the_pits.name: The Pits
base_the_pits.abilityText: Minions here are not affected by other players' actions.

base_bastion.name: Bastion
base_bastion.abilityText: After you destroy a monster here, draw a Treasure card.

base_the_gauntlet.name: The Gauntlet
base_the_gauntlet.abilityText: After a monster is destroyed here, play a monster here.

refresh_base.help: 💡 Click a base in play to refresh one base, or use the button below to refresh all of them.
refresh_base.empty_deck: The base deck is empty. Refreshing will clear all bases.

force_score.help: 💡 Set every base with minions to breakpoint 0 and resolve scoring immediately.

deal.description: This only works on the current remaining deck and never pulls cards directly from the full pool into the hand.

hand_preview.remove_card_title: Remove this card from hand (move it to the discard pile)
